crossRefs.note: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your…
Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…
“As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in…
In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you…
Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded…
For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges…

translations.web: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
translations.bsb: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
translations.kjv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
translations.asv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thine ordinances.
